description: Web UI Provider 配置功能 - 支持在 Web UI 中管理 LLM Provider 配置，包括查看、添加、删除、自定义 Provider，配置热重载和连接测试功能

tasks.title: Backend: Implement GET /api/providers endpoint
tasks.description: 创建 API 端点返回所有可用 Provider 列表，包括内置 Provider 和用户已配置的自定义 Provider。每个 Provider 包含 id、name、baseURL、models、configured、source、isBuiltin、isDefault、apiKeyMasked 字段。
acceptanceCriteria: Returns array of providers with all required fields
Shows correct configuration source (env/config/none)
Masks API Key in response (e.g., sk-ab*********789)
Includes both builtin and custom providers
tasks.notes: 从 ~/.mohist/config.jsonc 读取配置，从代码定义获取 builtin providers

tasks.title: Backend: Implement POST /api/providers/:id endpoint
tasks.description: 创建 API 端点保存或更新 Provider 配置到 ~/.mohist/config.jsonc。支持内置 Provider（仅 apiKey）和自定义 Provider（apiKey、baseURL、models、name）。
acceptanceCriteria: Validates apiKey is not empty
For custom providers: validates id format (a-z, 0-9, -)
For custom providers: validates baseURL format (valid URL)
For custom providers: validates models is non-empty array
Updates ~/.mohist/config.jsonc atomically
Returns success/error response with appropriate HTTP status
tasks.notes: 使用文件锁确保原子写入，避免并发问题

tasks.title: Backend: Implement DELETE /api/providers/:id endpoint
tasks.description: 创建 API 端点从 ~/.mohist/config.jsonc 移除 Provider 配置。
acceptanceCriteria: Removes provider from config.jsonc
Returns success response
Handles non-existent provider gracefully (204 or 404)
Atomically updates config file
tasks.notes: 删除自定义 Provider 或断开内置 Provider 配置

tasks.title: Backend: Implement Event Bus for config changes
tasks.description: 创建基于 Node.js EventEmitter 的事件总线服务，用于跨服务通信。ConfigService 可以触发事件，AgentRunnerService 可以监听事件。
acceptanceCriteria: EventBus service available for dependency injection
Supports emit(eventName, payload) and on(eventName, handler) methods
Type-safe event names using string constants
Proper cleanup to prevent memory leaks
tasks.notes: 使用单例模式或依赖注入管理 EventBus 实例

tasks.title: Backend: Emit events on provider config changes
tasks.description: 修改 ConfigService，在 Provider 配置保存或删除时触发 config:providers:changed 事件。
acceptanceCriteria: Emits 'config:providers:changed' event on POST /api/providers/:id
Emits 'config:providers:changed' event on DELETE /api/providers/:id
Event includes new provider configuration payload
Works for both Web UI and CLI changes
tasks.notes: EventBus 注入到 createProviderRoutes，POST 和 DELETE 时触发 'config:providers:changed' 事件

tasks.title: Backend: Implement config cache invalidation
tasks.description: 修改 ConfigService，在 Provider 配置变更时清除内部缓存，确保后续读取获得最新配置。
acceptanceCriteria: Cache cleared on save/delete operations
Next getConfig() reads fresh config from disk
Thread-safe cache operations (if using in-memory cache)
No stale config returned after changes
tasks.notes: 使用 Map 缓存 config 文件内容，writeConfig 时自动清除缓存，load() 时检查缓存

tasks.title: Backend: Implement AgentRunner hot reload
tasks.description: 修改 AgentRunnerService，监听 config:providers:changed 事件，动态重新初始化 LLM Provider。
acceptanceCriteria: Listens to 'config:providers:changed' events via EventBus
Reinitializes LLM provider with new config
Does not affect running agent instances (they use captured config)
Logs reload events for debugging
Handles errors during reinitialization gracefully
tasks.notes: 正在运行的 Agent 使用启动时的配置，新 Agent 使用最新配置

tasks.title: Backend: Implement POST /api/providers/test endpoint
tasks.description: 创建统一的连接测试端点，支持测试内置和自定义 Provider。发送廉价的 LLM 请求（max_tokens=1）验证连接。
acceptanceCriteria: Accepts full provider config (id?, name, apiKey, baseURL, sdk, models?)
If id provided, loads saved config from config.jsonc and merges with provided fields
Sends cheap LLM request (max_tokens=1) for testing
Returns { success: boolean, error?: string } response
HTTP 200 for successful test, HTTP 400 for failed test
tasks.notes: 使用 LLM SDK 发送测试请求，捕获各种错误类型

tasks.title: Backend: Implement connection test error handling
tasks.description: 处理连接测试的各种失败情况（认证错误、网络错误、超时等），返回用户友好的错误消息。
acceptanceCriteria: 401/403 errors return 'Authentication failed'
Network errors (ECONNREFUSED, ENOTFOUND) return 'Connection failed'
Timeout errors return 'Connection timeout'
Other errors return descriptive message
HTTP 400 for failures, 200 for success (not 500)
tasks.notes: 使用 error.status 和 error.code 属性区分错误类型，比字符串匹配更可靠

tasks.title: Backend: Implement rate limiting for test endpoint
tasks.description: 对连接测试端点实施限流，防止滥用。单人使用场景下限制每分钟 30 次。
acceptanceCriteria: Limit 30 requests per minute per IP or user
Returns 429 Too Many Requests when exceeded
Rate limit resets after 1 minute
Returns proper Retry-After header
tasks.notes: 使用简单的内存存储实现，使用 x-forwarded-for 或 x-real-ip 识别客户端 IP，60 秒窗口期清理过期记录

tasks.title: Frontend: Create Settings page with Providers tab
tasks.description: 在 Web UI 中新增设置页面，包含 Providers Tab。从导航栏可访问设置页面。
acceptanceCriteria: New Settings page accessible from main navigation
Providers tab is the default or most prominent tab
Responsive layout matching existing UI style (Tailwind CSS)
Route: /settings or similar
tasks.notes: 使用 shadcn/ui Tabs 组件，参考现有页面布局风格

tasks.title: Frontend: Implement React Query hooks for providers
tasks.description: 创建 React Query hooks 用于 Provider 数据的获取、缓存和更新。
acceptanceCriteria: useProviders hook: fetches and caches provider list
useSaveProvider hook: handles create/update with optimistic updates
useDeleteProvider hook: handles removal with confirmation
Proper error handling and loading states
Cache invalidation on mutation
tasks.notes: hooks 放在 hooks/ 或 queries/ 目录下

tasks.title: Frontend: Build Connected Providers section
tasks.description: 创建设置页面中的已连接 Provider 区域，显示已配置的 Provider 列表，支持断开连接。
acceptanceCriteria: Shows provider name, masked API Key, source tag (config/env)
Disconnect/Remove button for each provider
Empty state when no providers configured
Displays provider icon or avatar if available
tasks.notes: 使用 shadcn/ui Card 组件展示每个 Provider

tasks.title: Frontend: Build Available Providers section
tasks.description: 创建设置页面中的可用 Provider 区域，显示所有内置但未配置的 Provider。
acceptanceCriteria: Shows all builtin providers not yet configured
Connect button opens configuration dialog
Shows provider descriptions/notes
Hides already configured providers from this list
tasks.notes: 从静态定义获取 builtin providers 列表，使用 providers API 过滤未配置的 builtin providers

tasks.title: Frontend: Create Provider Connect Dialog
tasks.description: 创建对话框用于配置内置 Provider（如 OpenAI、Claude 等）。
acceptanceCriteria: Input field for API Key (password type with show/hide toggle)
Test Connection button (visible when API Key entered)
Save and Cancel buttons
Shows provider name and helpful text
Form validation for required fields
tasks.notes: Created ProviderConnectDialog.tsx with show/hide toggle, Test Connection and Save buttons, provider descriptions, and form validation

tasks.title: Frontend: Create Custom Provider Dialog
tasks.description: 创建表单对话框用于添加自定义 OpenAI-compatible Provider。
acceptanceCriteria: Fields: Provider ID, Name, Base URL, API Key, Models (comma-separated)
Validation feedback for each field (id format, URL format)
Test Connection button
Save and Cancel buttons
Help text explaining each field
tasks.notes: Created CustomProviderDialog.tsx with all required fields, validation (id format a-z0-9-, URL format, non-empty), Test Connection button, Save/Cancel buttons, and help text for each field

tasks.title: Frontend: Implement useTestProvider hook
tasks.description: 创建 React Query hook 用于测试 Provider 连接。
acceptanceCriteria: useTestProvider accepts provider config object
Returns mutate function and status (idle/pending/success/error)
Proper error handling and message extraction from response
Can be used in both connect and custom provider dialogs
tasks.notes: useTestProvider already implemented in useQueries.ts:219-223, returns mutate function and status (isIdle/isPending/isSuccess/isError). Used in ProviderConnectDialog.tsx:49 and CustomProviderDialog.tsx:89.

tasks.title: Frontend: Add Test Connection button to dialogs
tasks.description: 在 Provider 配置对话框中实现测试连接按钮，显示测试结果。
acceptanceCriteria: Button visible when API Key is entered
Shows loading state (spinner) during test
Displays success result (green checkmark + message)
Displays error result (red X + error message)
Result message is clear and actionable
tasks.notes: Added CheckCircleIcon and XCircleIcon components to both ProviderConnectDialog and CustomProviderDialog. Test results now display with green checkmark for success and red X for errors, with clear actionable messages.

tasks.title: Frontend: Implement test button debouncing
tasks.description: 防止用户频繁点击测试按钮导致重复请求。
acceptanceCriteria: 2-second debounce on test button click
Visual feedback that request is in progress (button disabled/loading)
No duplicate requests sent
User can test again after debounce period or when inputs change
tasks.notes: 使用 lodash debounce 或简单的 setTimeout 实现

tasks.title: Backend: Integrate hot reload across services
tasks.description: 将 EventBus 集成到 ConfigService 和 AgentRunnerService，完成热重载功能。
acceptanceCriteria: Services properly inject EventBus via dependency injection
End-to-end test: save provider via API, agent uses new config
No memory leaks in event listeners (proper cleanup on service shutdown)
Events work correctly across service boundaries
tasks.notes: Store listener as class property for proper cleanup; shutdown() called on SIGTERM/SIGINT; EventBus already injected via constructor

tasks.title: Frontend: Add pre-save connection validation
tasks.description: 在保存自定义 Provider 配置前，可选地执行连接测试，如果未测试则警告用户。
acceptanceCriteria: Detects if test was not run before save (track test state)
Shows warning dialog with 'Test First' and 'Save Anyway' options
Allows user to cancel and test first
Warning only for custom providers (builtin providers are known to work)
tasks.notes: Added showWarning state, resets testResult when fields change, shows amber warning dialog with Test First and Save Anyway options before saving custom provider
